reviewer: Codex full-resolution visual and provenance review
criteria: Every selected image was checked at full available resolution for exact species identity, visible diagnostic traits, range-consistent provenance, composition, sharpness, and a reusable CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or public-domain license. Near relatives, wrong hornbill species, illustrations, specimens, isolated body parts, heavily obscured subjects, and lower-quality alternatives were rejected. Research-grade living observations were preferred; captive photographs were accepted only when the exact species was unambiguous and the image materially improved identification quality.

approvals.visual_result: Sharp near-full adult with the velvet-dark torso, pale face, large ears and diagnostic zebra-striped legs unobscured. The zoo setting is not presented as wild habitat and was chosen for identification clarity.

approvals.attribution: (c) Connor Margetts, some rights reserved (CC BY)
approvals.visual_result: Exceptionally sharp full lateral animal in arid Australia; conical spines, false head, banded camouflage and short tail are all visible.

Wild Malaysian adult framed in the canopy; the massive solid red casque, long bill, bare red neck and black plumage are sharply diagnostic. Wider photographs were too distant, while a superficially attractive Commons candidate was rejected as a different hornbill species.

approvals.visual_result: Living frog on a Vietnamese mossy trunk with the entire outline, tuberculate green-brown skin, broad head and camouflage effect visible. It is less close than one alternative but substantially higher resolution and ecologically honest.

approvals.attribution: (c) Tom Heijnen, some rights reserved (CC BY)
approvals.visual_result: Daylight Namibian habitat photograph with the full animal visible; narrow muzzle, tall ears, sloping back and black vertical stripes clearly separate it from larger hyenas.

approvals.visual_result: Sharp full living animal on a Philippine seafloor; raised papillae, walking arms and vivid purple-yellow-orange warning display are unobscured.

approvals.visual_result: High-resolution Queensland reef photograph showing several living adults; the enormous heavy shells, thick folded mantles and blue iridophore spots are clear.
Sharp wild Northern Territory individual displaying the fully expanded pleated frill; body, limbs, claws, open mouth and surrounding savanna are all visible.
High-resolution living mountain bongo photographed at Mount Kenya; the full adult, spiral horns, orange coat, facial chevrons and numerous narrow white body stripes are sharply visible.

approvals.visual_result: Sharp complete adult in full defensive wing display; both orange-black-white eyespots, barred body, long legs and spread tail are visible.
